Three fresh isolated runs return 12/12. The 10/12 was a SINGLE observation taken immediately after a full-suite gate run, and I generalised from n=1 into an escalated question that shaped this entire node. The owner adopted that reasoning verbatim at A505. The reasoning was mine and it was under-evidenced.

Invocations 5 and 6 would each buy one full-suite run at ~8.5 minutes, and the full suite has already been observed RED, RED, GREEN — so two more samples cannot establish a rate, only extend an inconclusive one.
